Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL MIS Executive Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ICSIL recruitment is MIS Executive. This is a contractual position announced for the Delhi region.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the MIS Executive post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the MIS Executive post in the Intelligent Communication Systems India (ICSIL) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the MIS Executive role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com degree along with an Advance Diploma in Computer Application to be eligible for the MIS Executive position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the MIS Executive post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the MIS Executive post is 30 years. No minimum age is specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the MIS Executive position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the MIS Executive post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/- plus EPF.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ICSIL recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled for the MIS Executive post?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the MIS Executive post is scheduled to be held on 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for the MIS Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories (General/OBC, SC/ST) is Rs. 590/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the MIS Executive role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the MIS Executive role includes an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the ICSIL office in New Delhi. The exact address and timing details are available in the official notification.
